verdict.rationale: Statsig is an analytics and experimentation platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis, but the pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the Statsig console. The MCP server lets external AI clients (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code) query Statsig data, which is an outside-the-product integration rather than in-product insights. The AI evals, OpenAI integration and Azure stats-engine 'insights' cover experimenting on the customer's own AI apps, not AI analysis of the user's data, so they earn no credit here.
